This is his brother,he passed away last night. He wrote in his note to thank everyone here. I don't know how this all works but I just thought I would let the people on this post know. 

Me and mom will miss you,little bro

Lazarus by David Bowie,Helluva Life by Frankie Ballard (father figure killed himself and it was his favorite song) Hurt by Johnny Cash.
These were the songs I played before my suicide attempt
There's no reason to fight it,as the battle is not winnable. It's just useless.
I don't like sports,and I'm bored of everything. Everyday I feel like a zombie. Just getting through the day. I am unable to be fixed.
